overview: Extract ReminderSegmentViewModel from ReminderSegmentDetailView (714 lines — the largest file). View handles filtering, sorting, grouping across 5 segments. VM takes all business logic; view becomes thin consumer.
goals: Create @Observable ReminderSegmentViewModel owning segment filtering, sorting, grouping, quick capture, completion, scheduling, rescheduling, overdue management
Reduce ReminderSegmentDetailView from ~714 lines to ~250 lines
All segment operations testable without view lifecycle
nonGoals: No behavioral changes to segment display
No changes to ReminderSegmentLogic or TaskUIModel helpers
successMetrics: All 5 segments (Today, Tomorrow, Upcoming, Later, Overdue) render identically
rules: View holds @Query, passes data to VM via update()
VM delegates to existing ReminderSegmentLogic and TaskUIModel helpers
Timer.publish stays in view; VM exposes refreshNow()
